fields.name: Giridhara Dāsa (disciple of Narahari Sarakāra)
fields.notes:
A disciple of Narahari Sarakāra Ṭhākura; he wrote the Parakīya-rasa-sthāpana-siddhānta-saṅgraha, kept in the library of Rākhālānanda Ṭhākura at Śrīkhaṇḍa.

The record also held three Giridhara Dāsas translators (of the Smaraṇa-maṅgala, of the Manaḥ-śikṣā and of the Gīta-govinda), now in records of their own (07-11-2026).
Taken out of the record «Giridhara Dāsa» #331, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Jagannātha (uncle of Jāhnavā Mātā)
fields.notes:
A brāhmaṇa of Nityānanda's branch, the second son of Kaṁsāri Miśra and an uncle of Jāhnavā Mātā, the wife of Nityānanda Prabhu (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.48).

The record also held four other Jagannāthas: the son of Kānhāi Khuṇṭiyā, Tārakā, the disciple of Rasikānanda and the disciple of Śyāmānanda, now in records of their own (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Jayagopāla Dāsa (father of Balarāma dāsa)
fields.notes:
The father of Balarāma dāsa of the famous Maṅgala Ṭhākura family of Kāṇḍaḍā in Burdwan; he wrote the Kṛṣṇa-vilāsa and the Jñāna-pradīpa, and was a disciple of Sundarānanda.

The record also held the Jayagopāla Dāsa guru of Ghanaśyāma dāsa, author of the Bhakti-bhāva-pradīpa, now in records of their own (07-11-2026).
Taken out of the record «Jayagopala Dāsa» #600, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Mādhava (of Vṛndāvana, CC Madhya 13.51)
fields.notes:
There were two devotees named Mādhava in Vṛndāvana, both from Bengal; nothing more is known of them (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 13.51).

The record also held five other Mādhavas: Puṇḍarīka Vidyānidhi's friend, the one of Nityānanda's branch, the disciple of Rasikānanda, the poet, and the Oḍiyā disciple of Gadādhara, now in records of their own (07-11-2026).

fields.notes:
He belonged to the branch of Lord Nityānanda (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.52).

The record also held the Śaṅkara of Kulīna-grāma (Caitanya's branch) and the Śaṅkara disciple of Rasikānanda, now in records of their own (07-11-2026).
A resident of Kulīna-grāma of the branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.80). Taken out of the record «Śaṅkara» #1366, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
